items.t: Water pump leaking coolant or whining
items.job: Replace water pump and drive belt
items.note: Shop quotes range from about $380 to over $900 depending on the shop and what else is replaced.

items.t: Engine failure or blown head gasket at high mileage
items.job: Head gasket repair, or replace engine with a used unit
items.note: A head gasket job is at the low end (owners report about $1,400). A used replacement engine is at the high end (owners report about $3,500).

items.t: Oil leak from the timing chain cover
items.job: Reseal timing chain cover
items.note: Owners report $1,300 to $2,300 when the water pump or other seals are done at the same time. Check the cheap oil pressure switch first.

items.t: Engine burning oil
items.job: Diagnose oil consumption and update engine computer per bulletin
items.note: Price covers an oil consumption test and reflash. Worn piston rings would cost far more.

items.t: Brief rattle or knock at cold start
items.job: Replace camshaft timing (VVT) gear

items.t: Long cranking, no start or misfire codes
items.job: Diagnose no-start and update engine computer per bulletin

items.t: Misfire from a failed ignition coil
items.job: Replace ignition coil (and spark plugs)
items.note: Low end is one coil. Owners who replaced all four coils and plugs at a shop paid about $400 to $550.

items.t: Alternator stops charging
items.job: Replace alternator
items.note: Owners report about $560 to $900 at a shop.

items.t: ABS, VSC and brake lights on from a rear wheel speed sensor
items.job: Replace rear wheel speed sensor or wiring
items.note: If the rear hub assembly must be replaced too, owners report $500 to $950.

items.t: Water on the passenger floor from a blocked A/C drain
items.job: Clear A/C evaporator drain tube
items.note: Drying or replacing wet carpet padding costs extra.

items.t: Clear coat cracking or peeling
items.job: Refinish affected panels
items.note: Owners report an average of about $900. Price rises with each panel painted.

items.t: Driver's power window switch can overheat (recall)
items.job: Inspect and regrease or replace power window master switch

items.t: Front seat may not lock in place (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace front seat rail

items.t: Hard brake pedal in extreme cold (recall)
items.job: Install redesigned intake air connector

items.t: Load capacity label missing or wrong (recall)
items.job: Replace load capacity label

items.t: Starter clicks but engine won't crank
items.job: Replace starter motor

items.t: Wheel bearing hum
items.job: Replace one wheel bearing or hub assembly
items.note: Typical total is about $260 to $370 per wheel.

items.t: Manual transmission clutch slipping or wearing out
items.job: Replace clutch kit and resurface flywheel

items.t: Clicking from a worn CV axle
items.job: Replace front CV axle

items.t: Check engine light from the fuel vapor (EVAP) canister
items.job: Smoke test and replace charcoal canister
items.note: One owner paid about $1,400 for the canister and related parts.

items.t: Rear brakes or parking brake sticking
items.job: Replace rear calipers, pads and rotors
items.note: Cleaning and lubricating the rear brakes yearly is much cheaper and helps prevent this.
